# awscc_cloudwatch_alert (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::CloudWatch::Alert



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The AWS account ID that owns the alert.
- `alert_id` (String) The ID of the alert, assigned by CloudWatch when the alert is created. It doesn't change when the alert is updated, and it is the resource ID in the alert's ARN.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the alert.
- `created_at` (String) The time the alert was created, in ISO 8601 format (UTC).
- `description` (String) A description of the alert.
- `name` (String) The display name of the alert. Names don't need to be unique within a space; the alert is identified by AlertId.
- `notification_rules` (Attributes List) The notification rules that determine when and where notifications are sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_rules))
- `notifications_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert sends notifications. When false, the alert is still evaluated and records its state, but sends nothing. Defaults to true.
- `profile_id` (String) The ID of the access profile the alert uses to run its query and send notifications.
- `rule` (Attributes) The rule that defines how the alert is evaluated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule))
- `space_id` (String) The ID of the space to create the alert in. Changing this value replaces the alert.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The time the alert was last updated, in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

<a id="nestedatt--notification_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification_rules`

Read-Only:

- `target` (Attributes) Where the notification is sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_rules--target))
- `trigger` (Attributes) The alert states that trigger the notification rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_rules--trigger))

<a id="nestedatt--notification_rules--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification_rules.target`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the target. For sns, the ARN of the Amazon SNS topic. For slack and pagerduty, the ARN of a CloudWatch Omni integration.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Settings specific to the target, as key-value pairs (up to 20). The keys depend on the integration type. Not used for sns targets.
- `type` (String) The target type. Valid values: sns, slack, pagerduty.


<a id="nestedatt--notification_rules--trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification_rules.trigger`

Read-Only:

- `state_values` (List of String) The alert states that trigger this rule. A notification is sent when the alert enters any listed state. If omitted or empty, every state triggers the rule.



<a id="nestedatt--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Read-Only:

- `telemetry_rule` (Attributes) A rule that queries telemetry, evaluates the result against a condition, and sets how missing data is handled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule))

<a id="nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.telemetry_rule`

Read-Only:

- `condition` (Attributes) The thresholds that set the alert's state. Specify at least one of WarningThreshold and CriticalThreshold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule--condition))
- `evaluation` (Attributes) How often the alert is evaluated, and how long a change must last before the state changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule--evaluation))
- `no_data` (Attributes) How the alert behaves when an evaluation returns no data. If omitted, the alert reports NODATA. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule--no_data))
- `query` (Attributes) The query the alert runs, and the language it is written in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule--query))

<a id="nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.telemetry_rule.condition`

Read-Only:

- `comparator` (String) The comparison operator. Valid values: GT, GTE, LT, LTE (greater than, greater than or equal to, less than, less than or equal to).
- `critical_threshold` (Number) The value at which the alert enters the CRITICAL state.
- `threshold_field` (String) The result field to compare against the threshold. Required when ThresholdMode is FIELD_VALUE.
- `threshold_mode` (String) How the threshold is applied. COUNT_OF_RESULTS compares the number of rows the query returns. FIELD_VALUE compares the value of ThresholdField in each result row; each row is tracked separately.
- `warning_threshold` (Number) The value at which the alert enters the WARNING state.


<a id="nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule--evaluation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.telemetry_rule.evaluation`

Read-Only:

- `interval_seconds` (Number) The time between evaluations, in seconds. Valid values: 30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 900, 1800, 3600.
- `pending_duration_seconds` (Number) How long a threshold breach must last before the alert changes state, in seconds. Must be a multiple of IntervalSeconds. 0 changes state immediately.
- `recovery_duration_seconds` (Number) How long the result must stay within its thresholds before the alert returns to OK, in seconds. Must be a multiple of IntervalSeconds. 0 returns to OK immediately.


<a id="nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule--no_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.telemetry_rule.no_data`

Read-Only:

- `treat_as` (String) The state to report when an evaluation returns no data. Valid values: OK, WARNING, CRITICAL, NODATA.


<a id="nestedatt--rule--telemetry_rule--query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule.telemetry_rule.query`

Read-Only:

- `expression` (String) The query expression. For PromQL, the series value is returned in a field named value.
- `language` (String) The query language. Valid values: SQL, PROMQL.




<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
